finalText:
**Fixed the flat-coupon bug.**

`pricing.js` changed the money into the shopper's currency first, then took off the coupon. But a flat coupon's `amount` is written in USD, so `$10 off` was being treated as `€10 off`. Now the coupon comes off in USD and the currency change happens last.

A `$10` coupon on a `$100` order in EUR is `€81`, not `€80`.

All 5 tests pass, 65ms. Run them with `node --test tests/pricing.test.js` — pointing `node --test` at the folder fails on this Node version.
